messages.author: 0a6a9c49b017f046
messages.subject: Re: reduce space between axis titles and axis
parts:
Hi Hadley,

here is an example:


library(ggplot2)

theme_bw(10)

cp <- qplot(uempmed, unemploy, data = economics, geom="path", log="y")
bp <- qplot(uempmed, unemploy, data = economics, log="xy") +
  geom_smooth(se = F)

pdf("polishing-subplot-bw.pdf", width = 4, height = 4)
subvp <- viewport(width = 0.4, height = 0.4, x = 0.75, y = 0.35)
bp
print(cp, vp = subvp)
dev.off()

The problem is even more severe for the inset plot for some reason.

Greetings,

Sebastian
